verdict.rationale: Modal's site advertises sandboxes with "Custom images, any dependency", and the JS/Go SDK guide shows creating a Sandbox with a specified Image. Stored sandbox snapshots offer a reusable, template-like starting state, though that API is marked experimental. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling an existing image from an external registry (true bring-your-own image), detailed image-definition docs in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-image sandboxes.
